muse.notes: Meta Model API. Model access can be preview/account dependent. Spark Open and Glimmer require a separate hosting endpoint; image/audio-specific APIs are outside this profile.

deepseek.notes: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions surface. Preserve native reasoning_content and tool-call history in the application.

qwen.notes: Supply the workspace- and region-specific Model Studio base URL in options.base_url; credentials and model availability must match that region. No default region is chosen.

kimi.notes: International Kimi API endpoint. Kimi Code subscriptions and regional endpoints can have different credentials and access.

glm.notes: Standard Z.ai API endpoint, not the dedicated GLM Coding Plan endpoint. ZAI_API_KEY is this adapter's runtime environment convention.

minimax.notes: OpenAI-compatible text surface. MINIMAX_API_KEY is this adapter's runtime environment convention; direct OpenAI SDK use must pass its value explicitly. Preserve reasoning_content on subsequent tool turns.

cohere.notes: Cohere's compatibility API, not its native v2 Chat API. Supported settings and tools are limited by the compatibility surface.

nvidia.notes: Hosted NVIDIA API Catalog endpoint. This does not deploy a self-hosted NIM or guarantee every model accepts tools or a system prompt.

openrouter.notes: Gateway inference, with author/model IDs supplied by the caller. The official OpenRouterTeam/openrouter Terraform provider manages platform administration, not saved agent definitions.
